biography:
☢, Born into the minor nobility of the Crimson Empire, he was heir to a declining merchant house that lost everything to imperial bureaucracy and corporate rivals. Stripped of his title and watching his family's fortune evaporate, he turned to the very empire that failed him, using his noble education and knowledge of imperial trade routes to prey upon the wealthy merchant vessels he once envied. The nickname 'Barnacle' stuck after his first captain remarked that he was as persistent and hard to remove as the crustaceans that cling to hulls. 

☢ speaks with the refined, slightly haughty accent of the Crimson Empire's upper class, often peppering his speech with archaic imperial phrases and formal addresses that contrast jarringly with his criminal activities. He affects an air of wounded dignity and maintains a courtly manner even while threatening violence, as if he's merely conducting business rather than committing piracy. He's known to quote imperial regulations and tax codes ironically while boarding ships, and treats each raid with the meticulous attention to detail of a bureaucrat filing forms—cold, calculating, and infuriatingly polite about it.
